dct_description_sm: The aim of our study was to examine impacts of land management on aboveground and belowground edge effects, measured by changes in plant community, soil properties, and soil microbial communities across agroecosystem edges. This repository contains data collected for the study, including plant composition and biomass, soil properties (total carbon, total nitrogen, pH, nitrate, and ammonium), and soil fungal and bacterial community composition across perennial grassland-annual cropland edges.
dct_publisher_sm: Federated Research Data Repository / dépôt fédéré de données de recherche
dct_subject_sm: Sciences de la Terre et sciences de l'environnement connexes
dct_title_s: Living on the edge: fungal community strongly influenced by land management perennial grassland-cropland edges-data
